description: Get a single Monitor's full configuration and dashboard link. Configuration only — a Monitor's steps are its Script's commands, so read them with get_script. To start a disabled Monitor, call enable_monitor at the "Launch" access level; below that level a call is refused, and the user enables it in the Dashboard at the link. The 'monitoring' topic covers what a Monitor's configuration should be.
name: get_monitor
title: Get Monitor
